text:
Alex P: @eng-infra thinking about a new Grafana dashboard to help with GPU node lifecycle + power normalization across racks. Goal: correlate GPU utilization, memory pressure, thermal spikes, and per-rack power draw normalized by expected baseline. Want panels, variable filters (age, rack, pool), and suggested PromQL + alert rules. Anyone built something similar? :wave:

Maria S: love this. We have ad-hoc panels but nothing that ties expected vs actual power. Useful for capacity planning + retire/reprovision decisions. Two asks: 'node_age_days' buckets and 'expected_power_watts' baseline per rack.

Chris L: agree. We should also show 'efficiency' = tokens/sec per watt for inference nodes (if available). For raw metrics here's a starter PromQL for per-node GPU util:

```
avg by (node) (rate(nvidia_gpu_utilization_percent[2m]))
```

and per-rack power draw:

```
sum by (rack) (node_power_draw_watts) 
```

To normalize:

```
(sum by (rack) (node_power_draw_watts)) / on(rack) group_left() rack_power_baseline_watts
```

Jia K: For memory pressure panel use:

```
max by(node) (gpu_memory_used_bytes / gpu_memory_total_bytes) * 100
```

Also recommend recording rule to precompute per-rack normalized_power_ratio.

Maria S: Alert suggestions:
- rack_normalized_power_ratio > 1.15 for 5m -> investigate power anomaly
- avg gpu_utilization < 15% for 30m while normalized_power_ratio > 0.9 -> underutilized but power-hungry
- thermal_streaks: count_over_time(gpu_temp_celsius > 85 [15m]) > 3 -> schedule triage

Alex P: UI/UX: Add dashboard variables: env (prod/staging), rack, node_age_bucket (<30,30-90,>90), model_pool. Pre-filter panels by pool label.

Chris L: Implementation notes: use Grafana transform to join per-node and per-rack series, enable time shift to compare baseline week-over-week. Add links to node inventory (internal app) using template variable.

sre-bot: [alert rule created] gpu/rack_power_anomaly firing_count=0

Alex P: I'll spin up a draft in Grafana staging and post link. Can someone review queries once posted? Thanks :thumbsup:

Maria S: happy to review, tagging @chris

Chris L: I'll review later today.
